name: Belfry of Bruges
description: A medieval bell tower on the main square, 83 meters tall, with a carillon of 47 bells.

name: Markt
places: Statue of Jan Breydel and Pieter de Coninck, Markt
description: The main market square, lined with guild houses, with a statue of two leaders of a 1302 uprising against the French king.

name: Burg
description: A square with the Gothic city hall and the Basilica of the Holy Blood, a chapel built to hold a relic said to be Christ’s blood.

name: Saint John’s Hospital
description: A medieval hospital, one of the oldest in Europe, now a museum with paintings by Hans Memling, a 15th-century Flemish painter.

name: Rozenhoedkaai
description: A quay where two canals meet, with a view of old houses and the belfry tower above them.

name: Church of Our Lady
description: A Gothic church with a brick tower over 115 meters tall. It holds a marble Madonna and Child by Michelangelo.

name: Begijnhof
description: A walled courtyard of white houses around a lawn, founded in the 1200s for beguines, laywomen who lived in a religious community.

name: Prinsenhof
description: A former residence of the dukes of Burgundy, who ruled Flanders and held court here in the 1400s. It is now a hotel.
